description: List the TikTok accounts you want to monitor. The tracker finds public posts that tag or @mention each account, labels why every post matched, and lets you narrow results by date, views and order.

addPostCountry.description: Look up the country TikTok records for every saved post (locationCreated, e.g. US, BR, JP). Useful for market breakdowns of who mentions you. Adds a few seconds per post.
addPostCountry.title: Add the country each post was made in

datePosted.description: Only look at posts published in this period.
datePosted.title: Posted within

downloadVideos.description: Download each saved video into this run's key-value store and add a permanent link to it (downloadedVideoUrl). TikTok's own video links only play inside TikTok, so turn this on when you need playable files. It makes runs slower and uses storage.
downloadVideos.title: Save video files

excludeOwnPosts.description: Leave out posts published by the tracked account itself, so you only see what other people say about it.
excludeOwnPosts.title: Skip the account's own posts

followRelatedVideos.description: After searching, open TikTok's related videos for every post that tags the account and keep related posts that also mention it (repeating a few hops). Often finds many extra tagged posts, mostly from creators who tag the account regularly. Slower, and needs at least 4096 MB of run memory.
followRelatedVideos.title: Also follow related videos

maxItems.description: Optional limit across all accounts in this run. Leave empty for no overall limit.
maxItems.title: Max posts in total

maxResultsPerProfile.description: Stop after this many saved posts for each account. TikTok search usually yields tens to a few hundred posts per account, so very high values simply mean 'everything found'.
maxResultsPerProfile.title: Max posts per account

mentionFilter.description: Every saved post carries a mentionType label: 'tagged' (the caption contains TikTok's clickable tag of the account), 'captionText' (the caption types @handle without a working tag) or 'searchResult' (TikTok search returned it for the handle, but the caption doesn't name the account). By default you get real mentions: tagged posts plus @handle captions.
enumTitles: Real mentions: tagged or @handle in the caption
Only posts with TikTok's clickable tag
mentionFilter.title: Which posts to keep

minPlayCount.description: Skip posts with fewer views than this. Leave empty to keep posts of any size.
minPlayCount.title: Minimum views

postedAfter.description: Exact cut-off date. Use a date (2026-10-01) or a relative age such as '3 days' or '2 weeks'. Works together with 'Posted within'; the stricter of the two applies.
postedAfter.title: Posted on or after

searchCountry.description: TikTok shows different posts in different countries. Pick a country to see the mentions people there get in their search results (for example Japan for Japanese posts). 'Any' uses the fastest connection. Runs with a country are slower.
searchCountry.title: Search from country

searchDepth.description: 'Standard' runs one search per account and reads every page TikTok returns. 'Deep' adds searches by plain handle, display name and #handle, a most-liked pass, several date ranges and the Photo tab, then merges them without duplicates. Deep finds noticeably more mentions but takes a few minutes per account. Set the run memory to at least 2048 MB for deep search.
searchDepth.title: Search depth

sortBy.description: How saved posts are ordered for each account. 'Most liked' and 'Newest first' look at every post found before keeping the top ones.
sortBy.title: Order of results

usernames.description: Brand or creator accounts whose mentions you want. Type a handle (nike), a handle with @ (@nike) or paste a profile link (https://www.tiktok.com/@nike). One account per line; duplicates are merged.
usernames.title: TikTok accounts to track
